items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kenny – you know who I’m talking about. [INTERVIEWER] Kenny Clarke. Klook.

ctx.x: You mention Diz and Bird, but you don’t mention the drummers they were playing with. Was it the overall music that got you, and not necessarily the drumming?
Both. Overall music and the drumming too, because Kenny – you know who I’m talking about.
